In Western Colorado! 🚁 HELICOPTER TOUR BUSINESS PARTNER WANTED 🚁
Have you ever dreamed of turning your passion for helicopters into a business?

We’re looking for the right person to partner with to build a helicopter tour business offering unforgettable aerial experiences and breathtaking views.

We’re looking for someone who:

• ✈️ Holds a helicopter pilot license

• 🩺 Has a current FAA medical certificate

• 🚁 Has a passion for aviation and providing an incredible customer experience

• 💼 Is interested in being an active business partner and helping build something from the ground up

• 🌄 Loves the idea of showcasing some of the most incredible scenery from the air

This is an opportunity to become part of a new helicopter tour venture with the potential to grow into something exciting and rewarding.

Serious inquiries only.

📧 Interested? Email:

chopper_jockey@yahoo.com

Tell us a little about yourself, your aviation experience, and why you’re interested in partnering.

🚁 Let’s build something that gets people excited to look up.
